capabilities: Encrypt selected text fragments inside a note
Encrypt entire notes as editable .mdenc files
Pack folders and external files into encrypted .fpack archives
Cache passwords in memory to auto-fill on decryption
extras: README warns the encryption has not been independently audited, forgotten passwords mean unrecoverable data, and regular backups are the user's responsibility. Desktop only on Windows/macOS for full features; a separate mobile plugin exists for Android/iOS. Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian stores notes and attachments as plain files on disk, so there is no built-in way to protect sensitive content with a password.

relations.evidence: use Frog Encrypter Mobile — files created by either plugin are compatible with each other

summary: Encryption plugin that encrypts selected text, whole notes, and any files in or outside the vault using AES-256-GCM with PBKDF2 key derivation.
